title: Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators
native_title: デジタル・ピンボール 「ラスト・グラディエーターズ」
overview:
A realistic pinball simulation with four themed tables: Gladiators, Knight of the Roses, Dragon Showdown and Warlock. Score by working the targets, lanes, ramps and bumpers, and before each ball pick one of three bonus options, such as a lit bonus round, an extra ball, a doubled playfield or super kickback.

Every table has multiball and nine special bonus rounds. Complete them all to open that table's Ultimate Round, like the Gladiator Show on the Roman arena table.

- Four tables, each with its own theme and rules
- Pre-launch bonus selection before every ball
- High scores recorded in the Last Gladiators Hall of Fame
